name: Villar del Rey (Spain)
description: Square red flag charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Villar del Rey (a crown between two lions on blue above a cauldron on red).
history: Municipal flag of Villar del Rey; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Villar del Rey arms — crown between lions above a cauldron
